digestSpec.algorithm: SHA-256 over canonical UTF-8 bytes, lower-case hex
digestSpec.tableOrder: fixed list above, alphabetical by table name
digestSpec.rowEncoding: one JSON object per row with every column present, columns sorted by name; NULL is explicit JSON null, never omitted
digestSpec.canonicalJson: UTF-8, compact, object keys sorted bytewise at every depth, array order preserved
digestSpec.timestamps: timestamptz columns rendered in UTC as YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MI:SS.UUUUUUZ
digestSpec.volatileColumnsAndTablesExcluded: idempotency_records, synthetic_demo_marker and _sqlx_migrations are not hashed; no hashed table has a volatile column
digestSpec.byteStream: for each table in order: the table name, a newline, the canonical JSON array of its rows, a newline
